title: Gaussian Process Bandits for AI System Optimization with Selectively Verified Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.17760v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gaussian process bandits exploit similarities among configurations to optimize prompts, retrieval systems, and agent workflows. In these applications, however, inexpensive model-based evaluations can disagree with trusted task outcomes. We study selective verification when an action is chosen before a diagnostic is observed and trusted feedback is informative on an unknown set of diagnostic states. A finite reliability class and a finite RKHS signal dictionary describe these two sources of uncertainty. We construct a fixed audit design that combines reliability coverage with reward separation and establish a finite-time regret bound that accounts for a hard audit budget and the rounds needed to obtain informative observations. A safe adaptive extension mixes this robust design with predictable Chernoff allocations while preserving a uniform identification floor and exact expected acquisition-cost accounting. translated_title: 基于选择性验证反馈的高斯过程老虎机用于AI系统优化
translated_abstract: 高斯过程老虎机利用配置之间的相似性来优化提示词、检索系统和智能体工作流。然而，在这些应用中，廉价的基于模型的评估可能与可信的任务结果不一致。我们研究了选择性验证问题，即在观察到诊断信息之前先选择动作，且可信反馈仅在未知的诊断状态集合上提供有效信息。我们用有限可靠性类和有限RKHS信号字典来刻画这两种不确定性来源。我们构造了一种固定审计设计，将可靠性覆盖与奖励分离相结合，并建立了考虑硬性审计预算以及获取信息性观测所需轮次的有限时间遗憾界。一种安全的自适应扩展将该鲁棒设计与可预测的Chernoff分配相结合，同时保持统一的识别下限和精确的期望获取成本核算。对于带符号坐标核……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文针对AI系统优化中模型评估与可信结果不一致的问题，提出了带选择性验证反馈的高斯过程老虎机方法，通过固定审计设计与安全自适应扩展，在硬性审计预算下建立了有限时间遗憾界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Gaussian process bandits with selectively verified feedback for AI system optimization, establishing finite-time regret bounds under hard audit budgets via a fixed audit design and a safe adaptive extension.
